title: The Three Stooges: Thankstooging #1
desc: They put the wobble in the gobble, the har-har in harvest, and the trip in tryptophan! It’s a Thanksgiving holiday extravaganza hosted by The Three Stooges and they’ve just been waiting to give you all the bird! Turkey - of course! Come watch as The Boys crash a beloved holiday tradition and hit it harder than Grandma Susie’s fruitcake. The laughs and slaps just keep coming in an issue stuffed with holiday fun! Don’t get stuck at the kiddie table, grab your copy today!
